args.description: Dungeon Matcher fantasy mobile game settings UI asset kit. Transparent background. Strict front view, crisp actual native pixel art, top-left lighting, clean broad pixel clusters, not painted. args.description: Four tiny coherent game settings glyphs in a perfectly spaced 2 by 2 sheet. Each glyph fits within a 26 by 26 pixel area in its own 32px cell, separated on transparent background. Top left a simple white beamed pair of musical eighth notes. Top right a simple white loudspeaker with two sound-wave arcs. Bottom left a simple WHITE DIAMOND enclosing a dot, with one small steady line on each side, icon for reduced motion and stable image, not arrows. Bottom right a WHITE UPRIGHT SMARTPHONE with dark screen and two tiny vibration marks. Dungeon fantasy pixel UI, native pixel art, strong very dark outline, off-white main fill and restrained lavender-gray bottom shadow. Clear simple silhouettes, mostly white like UI symbols, not 3D objects, no medallions, no borders, no labels, no text, no decorative skulls. Hard pixels only, no antialiasing.
